html:
G'oya

Bitta guruhdan to'rtta son kerak, ulardan uchtasi shartli. Har bir shartli son uchun CASE qatorga 1 yoki 0 beradi, SUM esa ularni qo'shadi. Yaroqsiz byulletenni "ha ham emas, yo'q ham emas" deb aniqlash kerak, va bunda NULL alohida e'tibor talab qiladi.

Yechim

SELECT station_id,
       COUNT(*) AS total,
       SUM(CASE WHEN choice = 'ha' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS yes_votes,
       SUM(CASE WHEN choice = 'yoq' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS no_votes,
       SUM(CASE WHEN choice = 'ha' OR choice = 'yoq' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) AS invalid
FROM ballots
GROUP BY station_id

Oxirgi CASE da shart yaroqli byulletenni tekshiradi, qolgan hamma narsa ELSE ga tushadi. choice NULL bo'lsa, shart rost emas va byulleten ELSE 1 bilan yaroqsizga sanaladi. Namunada 1-uchastkada 5 ta byulleten: 3 ha, 1 yo'q, 1 belgilanmagan.

Tuzoqlar

Yaroqsizni NOT IN bilan aniqlash. NULL NOT IN ('ha', 'yoq') rost emas, noma'lum, va belgilanmagan byulletenlar hech qayerda sanalmaydi. Natijada total boshqa uch sonning yig'indisiga teng kelmay qoladi:

Noto'g'riSELECT station_id,
       COUNT(*) AS total,
       SUM(CASE WHEN choice = 'ha' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS yes_votes,
       SUM(CASE WHEN choice = 'yoq' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS no_votes,
       SUM(CASE WHEN choice NOT IN ('ha', 'yoq') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS invalid
FROM ballots
GROUP BY station_id

Teskari xato: faqat NULL larni yaroqsiz deb sanash (COUNT(*) - COUNT(choice)). 'ikkalasi' va 'buzilgan' byulletenlar yo'qoladi.

ELSE 0 siz SUM(CASE ...) bitta ham mos qator bo'lmaganda NULL qaytaradi. 3-uchastkada "Ha" ovozi yo'q, u yerda 0 chiqishi kerak.
